citations.title: Upcoming Events in Mexico City · Get Your Tickets On RA

data.notes: April 2027 currently has confirmed stadium pop and Auditorio Nacional Latin/trova dates; major club and festival calendars for the month do not yet appear broadly announced.

events.title: Louis Tomlinson: How Did We Get Here? Latin America Tour
events.summary: Louis Tomlinson brings his How Did We Get Here? Latin America Tour to Estadio GNP Seguros on April 10, 2027. OCESA lists the Mexico City stadium date and links through to Ticketmaster sales.

events.title: Grupo Niche "Niche Disco Tour"
events.summary: Colombian salsa institution Grupo Niche plays Auditorio Nacional on April 18, 2027 as part of the Niche Disco Tour. The event page bills the show as a run through the band’s salsa anthems.

events.title: Silvio Rodríguez
events.summary: Cuban Nueva Trova figure Silvio Rodríguez performs at Auditorio Nacional on April 26, 2027. Ticketmaster states the show is part of his Mexico tour and lists his accompanying band and musicians.

events.title: Silvio Rodríguez — final added date
events.summary: Silvio Rodríguez adds a second Auditorio Nacional date on April 27, 2027. The Ticketmaster event page bills it as a new and final function following audience demand.

events.title: Espinoza Paz
events.summary: Regional Mexican singer-songwriter Espinoza Paz returns to Auditorio Nacional on April 21, 2027. Ticketmaster lists the concert as a new presentation after strong audience response to his prior show.

events.title: Alcalá Norte
events.summary: Spanish band Alcalá Norte is confirmed for Foro Puebla on April 24, 2027. The Ticketmaster event page lists the Mexico City date at the Roma-area venue.

events.title: Willie Colón Forever
events.summary: A Willie Colón tribute concert at Auditorio Nacional, billed as Willie Colón Forever, is confirmed for April 14, 2027. Ticketmaster describes it as a night honoring the salsa innovator’s legacy.
